description: Defines the PlayerComponentsFactory class and related classes for creating and managing media player components, including tunnel mode support, audio/video decoders, and sink configurations, specifically for Android shared environment.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkAndroid
classes.description: Custom audio sink implementation supporting tunnel mode with specific audio session ID.

classes.name: AudioRendererSinkCallbackStub
classes.description: Stub callback for audio sink to handle source status and errors.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsPassthrough
classes.description: Implementation of PlayerComponents that uses passthrough audio and video renderers.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating media player components, supporting tunnel mode, decoder creation, and sink configuration.

methods.name: CreateComponents
methods.description: Creates player components, including decoders and renderers, based on creation parameters.

methods.name: CreateSubComponents
methods.description: Creates specific sub-components like decoders and render algorithms based on parameters.

methods.name: GetAudioRendererParams
methods.description: Calculates and returns parameters for audio renderer buffer sizes.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a video decoder with specific parameters and error handling.

methods.name: IsTunnelModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if tunnel mode is supported given creation parameters.

methods.name: GenerateAudioSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique audio session ID for tunnel mode.

methods.name: TryToCreateTunnelModeAudioRendererSink
methods.description: Attempts to create and verify a tunnel mode audio renderer sink.
